A balanced 2-week plan with weekday 2-hour sessions and weekend 4-hour sessions. It rotates **math, biology, and history** with light review built in so each subject gets repeated practice before finals.

## 2-Week Calendar-Style Study Schedule

| Date | Day | Study Time | Focus | Daily Goal |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| 2025-06-01 | Sun | 4h | Math + Biology | Build core formulas and review key biology systems |
| 2025-06-02 | Mon | 2h | History | Cover one major period and make timeline notes |
| 2025-06-03 | Tue | 2h | Math | Practice problem sets and correct errors |
| 2025-06-04 | Wed | 2h | Biology | Review diagrams, processes, and vocabulary |
| 2025-06-05 | Thu | 2h | History | Work on causes, effects, and essay outlines |
| 2025-06-06 | Fri | 2h | Math + Biology | Mixed review and quick self-test |
| 2025-06-07 | Sat | 4h | History + Math | Deep review plus timed practice questions |
| 2025-06-08 | Sun | 4h | Biology + History | Active recall, summaries, and weak-area repair |
| 2025-06-09 | Mon | 2h | Math | Focus on hardest topic from weekend review |
| 2025-06-10 | Tue | 2h | Biology | Practice short answers and labeled diagrams |
| 2025-06-11 | Wed | 2h | History | Memorize dates, themes, and key comparisons |
| 2025-06-12 | Thu | 2h | Math | Timed quiz and formula recall |
| 2025-06-13 | Fri | 2h | Biology + History | Final mixed review and flashcards |
| 2025-06-14 | Sat | 4h | All 3 subjects | Full revision sweep and final confidence check |

## Study Time Allocation Pie Chart

Total study time: **32 hours**

- **Math — 12h** — 37.5%
